name: Traveler (Hydro)
notes: Both sources: Skill > Burst (> Normal Attack), a Hydro DMG Goblet and a CRIT Circlet, and 4pc Golden Troupe near the top. Sets differ: KQM leads with Marechaussee Hunter for personal damage, Golden Troupe and Nymph's Dream next; Game8's best are Nymph's Dream and Golden Troupe. Golden Troupe and Nymph's Dream lead (named by both), Marechaussee Hunter follows. Sands differ: KQM ATK% or EM, Game8 ATK% or HP%; all three are kept. KQM and Game8 also give support builds (Instructor, Noblesse Oblige, Deepwood Memories; EM builds with Flower of Paradise Lost, Gilded Dreams) that are not the main plan; Instructor and Flower of Paradise Lost are kept as options. Weapons: KQM Splendor of Tranquil Waters first, Game8 Primordial Jade Cutter first; both lists are kept with those two leading. The kit's 'check' lines (Torrent Surge DMG 189.3%, Dewdrop and Spiritbreath Thorn 32.8%) are the Skill's ATK-based Hydro damage on the elemental curve (ratio 1.80), with a small Max HP bonus from Suffusion, so the scaling stat is ATK and the damage talent the Skill. ER 180 is Game8's all-purpose figure (200 for its Bloom build); KQM gives no figure because the need varies. No ATK or CRIT goal is given.
